_doc: Replication. cost = Embers from the planet pool per copy; maxPerPlanet copies can live on one planet. Each copy inherits its parent's look and stats, then drifts: chances to change visor color, headgear (gear.json frame 1..6) and trail color (palette index), plus small stat nudges (multipliers, clamped). gatherPerHour = Embers one copy adds to the pool per real hour (times its gather stat), counted while nobody is playing up to offlineCapHours. tripMs = how often a copy brings back an Ember while you watch. blankDrift: since session 9 copies are born blank and choose their own look; their stats drift this fraction of the old amount.
